convergence.interpretation: OSW numerical convergence gates, not physical measurement uncertainty.

admission_decision.reason: Both numerical sweeps converge, but the daily ADT peak is about 125 km from the author-reported approximate MSEAS position and the reported model point is outside both selected core bounding boxes. A model position and a stable nearby contour alone do not establish that the DUACS core is the named secondary. No position error or cross-product identity match is established. Retain the successful numerical diagnostic separately from named-eddy measurements.
admission_decision.not_a_new_contour_rejection: No numerical gate changed; the frozen operator passed. Withholding is a source-association review decision, not a fabricated numerical failure.
admission_decision.next_evidence_needed: An independently named dated chart or recoverable model boundary/dataset that resolves the cross-product association. Any new source position must be retained as a new source case, not a moved seed for this run.

excluded_source_recovery: The earlier Haley 2023 archived PDF is truncated at 5 MiB; incomplete figures and parser-padded images were excluded in the linked primary position review. The position used here comes from explicit publisher-indexed text of Gao et al., DOI 10.1016/j.ocemod.2026.102841, not the damaged PDF.
